label: VWAP (rolling 4h) −3σ
gloss: the rolling 4h VWAP minus 3 volume-weighted standard deviations (line − 3·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (rolling 24h)
gloss: the volume-weighted average typical price of this timeframe's own bars over the 24h ending at the bar's close, as a chart of this timeframe computes it; absent on a rung whose bar is as long as the rolling 24h

label: VWAP (rolling 24h) +1σ
gloss: the rolling 24h VWAP plus 1 volume-weighted standard deviation (line + 1·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (rolling 24h) +2σ
gloss: the rolling 24h VWAP plus 2 volume-weighted standard deviations (line + 2·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (rolling 24h) +3σ
gloss: the rolling 24h VWAP plus 3 volume-weighted standard deviations (line + 3·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (rolling 24h) −1σ
gloss: the rolling 24h VWAP minus 1 volume-weighted standard deviation (line − 1·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (rolling 24h) −2σ
gloss: the rolling 24h VWAP minus 2 volume-weighted standard deviations (line − 2·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (rolling 24h) −3σ
gloss: the rolling 24h VWAP minus 3 volume-weighted standard deviations (line − 3·σ, σ = √(Σhlc3²·v / Σv − VWAP²) over the same bars)

label: VWAP (from swing high)
gloss: the volume-weighted average typical price of this timeframe's own bars since the open of the bar holding the latest decided swing high on this rung (2 bars each side); absent while no swing high is in reach

label: VWAP (from swing low)
gloss: the volume-weighted average typical price of this timeframe's own bars since the open of the bar holding the latest decided swing low on this rung (2 bars each side); absent while no swing low is in reach

label: Price zone
gloss: price location against the channel of the 20 bars before this one, near an edge in its outer 20%

label: Structure zones
gloss: the ACTIVE structure-zone set (fair-value gaps and order blocks)

label: TPO point of control
gloss: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC day, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC day's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC day's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Initial balance high
gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that initial balance closes

label: Initial balance low
gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that initial balance closes

label: TPO profile shape
gloss: where the point of control sits inside the current UTC day's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold

label: TPO point of control (prior UTC day)
gloss: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC day; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO profile shape (prior UTC day)
gloss: where the point of control sat inside the previous completed UTC day's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror

label: Initial balance high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the highest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

label: Initial balance low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lowest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

label: Volume point of control
gloss: the price bin holding the most typical-price-weighted VOLUME in the current UTC day — the volume sibling of tpoPOC, published beside it rather than replacing it, because time-at-price and volume-at-price disagree exactly where a UTC day ranged quietly or trended hard. Null where the UTC day traded nothing the fold can see — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area high
gloss: the upper edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — the same expansion rule as tpoVAH, over the volume tally — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area low
gloss: the lower edge of the current UTC day's 70% VOLUME value area — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume point of control (prior UTC day)
gloss: the price bin that held the most typical-price-weighted volume in the previous completed UTC day; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin
